reason: Three free months and 59 GEL after that is nothing for my place, and I'd love to know which guests are regulars and send them my Thursday event posts directly instead of hoping Instagram shows them. Verified-only dish reviews are also something tourists actually trust.
objection: My waiters will resist anything that changes how the bill and tips work. If guests pay by QR and walk out without leaving a tip, or the tip doesn't reach the waiter cleanly, I'll have a revolt on the floor and I'll switch it off. The payment partner's fee on top is also an unknown I want to see in writing.
would_change_my_mind: If the trial showed my waiters losing tips or guests skipping the tip screen, I'd cancel before paying; a clear built-in tip step that pays out to staff would keep me in.
